translation: Formerly I said I was lazy in using the mind; it is not that I am lazy in using my own mind, but that my own mind is lazy in being used by me; this is laziness. Why was it like that before rubbing and like this after rubbing, with the before and after differing within a month? Is it perhaps the earlier saying that it is itself disease? Since I began rubbing, I do not know whether the heart has been gathered back, nor whether it is willing to be used by me, so I composed one Discourse on the Heart and one self-verse; the heart does not seem to be entirely without a clue, but I do not know whether it was gathered by rubbing; it is one and two, two and one. Is it so, or not? If it is truly so, then laziness is after all a disease.
